index.title: Users
index.subtitle: Who works here and what each of them can do. A person can belong to more than one company — what you manage here is their access to yours.
index.inviteNote: They get an email with a link that works for seven days. Nobody gets in until they open it and set their own password.
index.pendingHint: They already have access granted. It starts the moment they open their email.

fields.emailHint: If they already have an account, this adds your company to it — it does not create a second one.
fields.carrierHint: Which carrier this person belongs to. They will only see that carrier's work.

roleHelp.admin: Everything, including users, settings and money.
roleHelp.accounting: Invoices, settlements, expenses and reports. Does not dispatch.
roleHelp.dispatcher: The loads of the carriers assigned to them, and nothing else.
roleHelp.carrier: The carrier portal: their own loads, drivers, equipment and documents.
roleHelp.driver: Only their own loads and documents.

accept.title: Join {company}
accept.subtitle: You have been invited as {role} at {company}.
accept.existingAccount: You already have an account. Sign in with the password you already use — this invitation just adds this company to it.
accept.invalid: The invitation link is not valid, has already been used, or has expired. Ask whoever invited you to send it again.

mail.subject: You have been invited to {company}
mail.intro: {inviter} has invited you to join {company} on Goliath Dispatch as {role}.
mail.expiry: The link works for seven days.
mail.ignore: If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this message — nothing happens until you open the link.

errors.alreadyMember: That person already has this role in your company.
errors.alreadyInvited: That person has already been invited and has not answered yet. Resend the invitation instead.
errors.notPending: That invitation is no longer pending.
errors.notActive: That membership is not in a state where this can be done.
errors.notYourself: You cannot change your own role or access. Ask another administrator.
errors.lastAdmin: This is the last active administrator. Promote someone else first, or the company is left with nobody who can manage it.
errors.carrierRequired: Choose which carrier this person belongs to.
errors.carrierNotFound: That carrier does not exist or is not yours.

flash.invitedExisting: {email} already had an account. Your company has been added to it and the invitation is on its way.
flash.resent: Invitation resent to {email}. The previous link no longer works.
flash.revoked: Invitation withdrawn. The link in that email no longer works.
